In this episode we are taking a domestic flight to the east coast of Fujian Province, Pingtan, for the Kitefoil World Series.

The Formula Windsurfing Junior Youth & Masters European Championship 2013 was held in the stunning Azores archipelago.

One of the many charms of the island of Vis lies in its 500 years long isolation as a military island. Vis has an unspoiled nature, magical beaches and the hospitality of its people is so authentic it will make you want to stay in this place forever.

Hello sailors! In this episode we will be island hopping the Zadar archipelago. We will visit the islands of  Ugljan, Pašman and Pag, and our first stop will be the Ugljan, also known as the Olive Island.

One of the most physically testing competitions is coming soon to Nautical Channel. The Dusi Canoe Marathon is a one of a kind canoe and running endurance race set in the magnificent South African Drakensberg hills and rapids.

We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1.

We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup.
